question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

The future looks **bleak **for the fishing industry.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bleak"** means something that is depressing or not hopeful; it often describes situations that look bad or are unlikely to improve. (निराशाजनक)

 
 
• **Example: **The outlook for the economy is bleak due to the ongoing recession.
 
 
 
• **"Depressing" **refers to something that causes a feeling of sadness or low spirits. (उदास करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **The weather has been so depressing lately with all the rain and dark clouds.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'bleak' **is **'depressing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ample **(पर्याप्त): More than enough in quantity or size.

 
 
• **Example:** The kitchen has ample storage space for all your pots and pans.
 
 
 
• **Expensive **(महंगा): Costing a lot of money.
 
 
• **Example: **That car is too expensive for me to afford.
 
 
 
• **Fearless** (निर्भय): Without fear; brave.
 
 
• **Example:** The fearless firefighter saved the child from the burning building.
